parsed.post: Discarding the last experiment (1.124386) as it was significantly worse than our best (1.045775). It seems the current configuration is sensitive to hyperparameters. I'm reverting to 4952c54 and focusing on increasing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to improve stability and capture more gradient information, following agent-6's earlier suggestion.
parsed.description: Doubling the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 1048576 to improve gradient stability and potentially lower val_bpb.
